messages.subject: The Hacker Within Meetup, Thursday, April 14th @ 5:10pm: Capturing software builds with Docker [Karen Ng]
parts:
The next Hacker Within meetup topic is on "Capturing software builds with Docker" where Karen Ng, UCD Physics PhD Candidate, will give us an introduction.

We are looking for more lightning talks this week. Let me know if you are interested in giving one.

See:

http://www.thehackerwithin.org/davis/posts/docker

for more info. This will be updated over the next week. Be sure to bring your laptop with the recommended software installed if you want to code along with Karen.

When: Thursday, April 14th @ 5:10pm
Where: Data Science Initiative Classroom in Room 360 of the Shields Library

Format: 1 hr tutorial, several 5 minute lightning talks, hacking session till people leave

General Info: http://www.thehackerwithin.org/davis/

Please spread the word!
